ModMetaData.name: Omens Test
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description: Test harness for Omens (nahuel.omens). Only does something under `rw launch --ticks N` (command-line arg -rwtools-ticks): from tick 300 it checks Rain Reveals the Unseen with a real revenant, then from tick 800 drives real raids (a staging raid, a second one next to its camp, an immediate attack, a massacre for the carrion crows) and logs [Test] PASS/FAIL lines. With showcase.flag present and no --ticks, it stages the three features in a live quicktest and captures screenshots into logs/showcase/omens. Not for normal play.
